workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: Members of the Teachers’ Unit, except counselors and librarians, shall work one hundred and eighty-five (185) days.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: Seven hours 35 minutes on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday; 8 hours 30 minutes on Wednesday; 7 hours on non-student days
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The workday of a teacher shall be: i) Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday – seven (7) hours and thirty-five (35) minutes. ii) Wednesday – eight (8) hours and thirty (30) minutes... iv) The length of the teacher workday when students are not in attendance will be seven (7) hours

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: The full-time teacher shall have a minimum of 250 minutes of on-site individual planning time each week.

workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: The full-time teacher shall have a minimum of 250 minutes of on-site individual planning time each week.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: No meetings can be called by administration on workdays. / One Wednesday every month will be designated for teacher planning and preparation time. This one Wednesday: Will not be used for voluntary or mandatory meetings scheduled by administration

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: The teacher shall have a thirty (30) minute duty-free lunch period.
